_meta.purpose: Caregiver persona + convergent/divergent axis.  Convergent/divergent is a thinking-style axis (single-best-answer vs many-possible-paths).  Caregiver is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.50, n=4) -- both a convergent caregiver focused on the one right intervention and a divergent caregiver enumerating options are recognisable.  Question mix: 5 convergent-trait 'what's THE best way' prompts (single-answer-prompting) + 4 divergent-trait 'what are WAYS to X' prompts (enumeration-prompting) + 3 caregiver-domain emotional advice prompts + 1 extraction value-probe + 1 hand-written convergence-prompted probe.
design_notes: Convention: pos=convergent, neg=divergent.  YAML sets role_from=convergent, role_to=divergent; sign=+1 steers toward divergent.
Non-goal cognitive-style axis; expect symmetric response.  Prompt wording ('what's THE best' vs 'what are ways') deliberately matches each pole's grain.
